courses.title: (SCTP) Advanced Certificate in Data Communications and Visualisation for Business Analyst
courses.summary: Data visualisation, data preparation, charts, storytelling, dashboards and a capstone. Tools include Tableau, Excel and Python libraries. The published duration is 330 hours over three months; this is not the hypothetical six-month programme.
courses.cost_note: Published full headline fee. Confirm all costs with the provider; reduced fees depend on eligibility.
courses.schedule_note: 330 hours over 3 months (12 weeks), including asynchronous, synchronous, classroom and assessment hours. Next start is to be advised; weekend-only attendance is not established.
courses.prerequisite_note: Published application conditions include Singapore Citizen, Permanent Resident or LTVP+ holder; at least 21 years old; self-sponsored. Personal eligibility is not established.
courses.funding_note: Provider lists conditional funded fees. Salary, a synthetic persona or a brand ambition does not establish eligibility or entitlement.
